raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fix the MiMo-V2 target model's attention sink bias load. `load_weights` slices the checkpoint tensor for the local TP rank, then uses the same current parameter loader path as other weights.

The MTP model already follows this contract and is unchanged. This PR changes only `mimo_v2.py`.

## Validation

- `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, and `git diff --check` pass.
- The integrated static audit finds no direct checkpoint sink copy. The new runtime tests have not been executed, as requested.

## AI assistance

AI assistance was used.

nodes.body:
﻿## Verification on H20

**Verified commit:** `50ffbf6b74a8b888e72b90ef07247093f80e2bb1` (this PR's head; it covers MiMo-V2 target)
**Integration commit:** `c623df9e4bfe1133a3205b94e2d771ba43876ec7` (`attn-sink-integration` = #57797 + #57798 + #57801 + #57803 + #57804 + #57805 + #57806)
### Environment

- Cluster: H20 Slurm, node `vllm-h20-01`, 1x NVIDIA H20-3e (`--partition=h20 --gres=gpu:h20:1`)
- Python: `$HOME/vllm-shared/prebuilt-venv/bin/python` (torch 2.13.0+cu130 + compiled vllm from the shared prebuilt baseline)
- Pure-Python change, so the verified revision was overlaid onto the prebuilt package with `make-overlay.sh`; nothing was recompiled.

### Results

| Suite | Where | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test_attention_sink_load_audit.py` (from #57806) | head node + GPU node | 39 passed |
| `test_attn_sink_reload.py` (from #57797) | head node (CPU) | 18 passed, 2 skipped (CUDA-only) |
| `test_attn_sink_reload.py` | H20 GPU | **20 passed** |
| GPU end-to-end sink reload script | H20 GPU | **8/8 checks passed** |

The GPU script drives a real layerwise reload (`record_metadata_for_reloading` -> `initialize_layerwise_reload` -> `load_weights` -> `finalize_layerwise_reload`) on CUDA tensors and asserts the live update lands in the kernel tensor storage with the `-inf` padding tail re-established and the storage pointer unchanged:

```text
PASS  live update reaches kernel tensor
PASS  live update re-establishes -inf padding
PASS  kernel tensor storage is stable
PASS  rank 1 live update loads its own heads
ALL GPU SINK CHECKS PASSED
```

### Pre-commit

```text
pre-commit run --files <changed files>
pass1 rc=0 dirty=0
pass2 rc=0 dirty=0
```

No hook rewrote a file. `run-precommit.sh` skips the `pip-compile` hooks because the sandbox cannot reach PyPI; no requirements file is touched here.

### Not verified

- No full-model checkpoint was loaded (no matching weights available), so this is loader/contract-level plus a real GPU reload, not a full-model accuracy run.
- Single GPU; TP>1 was exercised in-process via distinct rank head ranges, not as a multi-process TP run.

### What changed in this revision

The earlier revision reindented the whole tail of `load_weights` to drop an `else`, which also moved `maybe_remap_kv_scale_name` in front of the sink handling. That is unrelated to the sink write and changes behavior for a non-sink path. This revision keeps the sink branch self-contained: narrow, load through the current loader, `loaded_params.add`, `continue`. The diff is now the sink branch only.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

detail.body:
Fix the MiMo-V2 target model's attention sink bias load. `load_weights` slices the checkpoint tensor for the local TP rank, then uses the same current parameter loader path as other weights.

The MTP model already follows this contract and is unchanged. This PR changes only `mimo_v2.py`.

## Validation

- `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, and `git diff --check` pass.
- The integrated static audit finds no direct checkpoint sink copy. The new runtime tests have not been executed, as requested.

AI assistance was used.
detail.title: [Bugfix][RL] Load MiMo-V2 attention sink bias through weight_loader

files.patch:
@@ -841,15 +841,17 @@ def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
             if "attention_sink_bias" in name:
                 total_heads = loaded_weight.shape[0]
                 heads_per_rank = total_heads // tp_size
-                head_start = tp_rank * heads_per_rank
-                narrow_weight = loaded_weight.narrow(0, head_start, heads_per_rank)
-
-                param.data.copy_(narrow_weight)
-                loaded_params.add(name)
-            else:
+                local_weight = loaded_weight.narrow(
+                    0, tp_rank * heads_per_rank, heads_per_rank
+                )
                 weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
-                weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
+                weight_loader(param, local_weight)
                 loaded_params.add(name)
+                continue
+
+            weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
+            weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
+            loaded_params.add(name)
 
         return loaded_params
